thread:
sam: Heads-up — production console shows a sampling-rate spike for route-metadata events after today's proxy rollout. Saw a ton of empty/blank `x-route-sampling` headers which are getting counted as 'sampled' in analytics.
neha: Which services? any specific SDK versions? :eyes:
jules: infra-bot logged the deploy: infra-bot: deploy finished service=route-proxy sha=abcd123 tag=canary time=3872099900
alex: Observed in TS SDK v2.14.1 and Go client v1.6.0. Python client v0.9.8 seems fine.
maria: Quick grep on ingress logs shows headers like `x-route-sampling: ""` and `x-route-sampling: \r\n` — parser treats those as truthy.
rohit: That's the shim that normalizes header casing. If header present we forward it, even if empty. SDKs should probably omit the header when unset.
neha: Can we do a quick server-side fix to ignore empty values and not count them as sampled? That would stop the noisy spike while SDKs ship patches.
sam: Agreed. Plan proposal:
- server: treat empty/whitespace-only `x-route-sampling` as absent (fast rollback today)
- sdk: patch TS/Go to drop the header when sampling key is null/undefined
- python: double-check but probably already drops
- rollout: canary server-side change today, then SDK releases tomorrow

jules: +1. We should also add a console-side guard: when aggregating, filter out blank sampling keys and tag them `__missing__` so dashboards don't misattribute.
alex: Draft TS patch snippet:
```
// only set header if truthy string
if (samplingKey && typeof samplingKey === 'string' && samplingKey.trim()) {
  headers['x-route-sampling'] = samplingKey.trim()
}
```
maria: Devex ask: add migration note in changelog and a short QA checklist (simulate empty header and ensure console ignores it).
rohit: I'll open the server-side PR and add a metric to count dropped-empty-headers. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ignore-empty-sample-headers
infra-bot: rollout started: service=route-proxy canary=true at=3872100030
neha: thanks — i'll watch the console metrics and coordinate with support for customer noise. If all good, patch the SDKs and schedule minor releases.
sam: :thumbsup: Good cleanup. Follow-ups: rohit to PR + canary, alex/jules to ship SDK patches, maria to update changelog and console dashboard filter.
